# Praxis Automation snapshot

Follow the root Praxis instructions. This subtree is a controlled source snapshot
of openhands-automation 1.19.3 (MIT), consumed with the Praxis SDK sources.
Preserve its Python namespace, database migrations and runtime contracts.
Do not enable cloud services or publish to upstream repositories or registries.
Local integration uses AUTOMATION_AGENT_SERVER_URL and AUTOMATION_LOCAL_API_KEY.
